repair_instructions: Use one small C# Harmony patch in TestPatch. Add its target attribute and patch method. Keep the initializer. Write only original patch code; do not copy decompiled methods.
notes: Copy this config to games.local and replace each REPLACE value. A picture checker reads the final replay picture, returns 0 for the expected number, 1 for a clearly read wrong number, and 2 for an unreadable picture or an error. The same check runs with the fix off and on. Omit seed_profile to start fresh. Keep seed_profile unchanged between replays. The normal play check must replay a clean stretch and fail on changed behavior. No context file may be in source. Context is read only and never written to output. Set PLAYTEST_STS2_ROOT in local.env to the same test folder.
